claim: kThingObjectExplode (type 417) takes damage only from explosions (and half from tesla): its multipliers are 0 fall, 0 burn, 0 bullet, 256 explosion, 0 drown, 0 spirit, 128 tesla. Laid as a floor-aligned blocking sprite it is ground to walk on, because getzrange counts a blocking floor sprite as floor. So a manhole cover blown open by dynamite needs no wiring: a hole always there, under a flat 417.
evidence: built in Gravesend's manholes 2026-11-21; campaign census 2026-11-26: floor-aligned 417s 177 (59 blocking), floor-aligned 416s 77 (43 blocking); E4M9 sprite 290 is type 416, not 417; campaign census 2026-11-26: floor-aligned 417s 177 (59 blocking), floor-aligned 416s 77 (43 blocking); E4M9 sprite 290 is type 416, not 417
use: Lay the cover a little larger than the hole on the thing list. A floor-aligned blocking 417 is the campaign's own (59 of them, e.g. E1M4 sprite 277); a flat kThingObjectGib (416) such as E4M9 sprite 290 (data_1 5 for shards) also breaks to bullets, so use it only where shooting it open is wanted.
